---
title: "✨ Virtual Unconference 2026 ✨"
---

The NHS Open Analytics community and University of Edinburgh are excited to announce the inaugural Virtual NHS-OA Unconference! 
If we can't get together in person this year, we can at least keep the conversation going!

Date: **26th November**

Time **9.30-12.30**

Location: **MS Teams**

Who for: **UK-based NHS and DHSC employees and UK students aiming to become NHS employees**

To recreate the vibrancy of the ever popular unconference sessions of NHS-OA conferences of old, on November 26th we will be hosting a virtual get-together where you, the audience, get to decide the topics for discussion, move freely between 'rooms' and have your say! 
There will also be a chance to hang out and meet lovely new people in the more informal 'coffee area'.

[Register your interest](https://events.teams.microsoft.com/event/87859b16-2994-4a20-b5d4-7d641874e4c1@2e9f06b0-1669-4589-8789-10a06934dc61?source=copyLinkLegacyShareLinkDialog) to attend. 
Further details will be sent out to those who have registered in due course.
